book_title: Chapter 9: Bull vs. Bear, Likely Outcomes & Our No-FOMO Action Plan
question: Integrating Pass 1 forensics, FII/DII outflows, our stress-adjusted ₹480.00 Base Target, and 5 distribution days, what is our verdict, holding action, sizing math, and 100% capital redeployment plan?

epigraph.quote: Great investing lives in the gap between admiring a business and paying the right risk-adjusted price for it—demand asymmetric odds, require institutional volume confirmation, and write your kill-switch before buying.
epigraph.author: Institutional Portfolio Desk

web_blocks.title: Bull vs. Bear Steelman Debate (Post-Refresh Forensic Synthesis)

web_blocks.html: The Bull Steelman: Renamed International Gemological Institute Limited in May 2026, IGIL sets the global lab-grown diamond standard (~65% share). Its network spans 36 labs, 21 schools, colored-stone lab AGL, and wholly owned IGI Botswana (consolidated September 7, 2026) [29][30]. GIA's October 2025 exit from granular LGD 4Cs grades widened IGIL's moat. Fresh FY26 GJEPC data confirms Indian polished LGD exports (18.8 million carats) passed natural diamonds (16 million carats) [10][35]. Q2 FY27 revenue jumped +31% YoY to ₹398.0 Cr and PAT rose +43% YoY to ₹185.8 Cr. H1 operating cash flow hit ₹415.7 Cr (89% of EBITDA; 118% of PAT), while cash reached ₹1,074.9 Cr with zero bank debt. ICRA confirmed clean IPO use and the KS Trade LLC lawsuit was dismissed [30][31][39]. At 29.05x TradingView P/E (28.1x Screener) for 69.2% ROCE, IGIL trades far below Titan and Kalyan [1][43].

The Bear Steelman: Six verified risks argue against overpaying. First, Blackstone owns 76.55% ahead of a December 2027 SEBI MPS deadline [26], while FIIs fell 176 bps (10.55% to 8.79%) and DIIs fell 91 bps (6.38% to 5.47%) as retail rose +142 bps to 9.17% [1]. Note 47 also shows 19.55 million active ESOP 2024 options (~4.52% dilution), with 60% tied to sponsor exits [32][39]. Second, India standalone EBITDA margin fell 340 bps YoY to 69.5% in Q2 FY27 without standalone ex-AGL LGD ASP or commission disclosures, while Q2 PAT benefited from a 24% tax rate (vs. 27% norm) and ₹64 Cr TTM treasury income [1][30][40]. Third, the 10% U.S. Section 301 diamond tariff (July 2026) cut direct U.S. export share from ~40% to ~15% and stressed Surat cutters right after IGIL cut ECL reserves to 1.82% [34][35][39]. Fourth, post-AGL goodwill and intangibles hit ₹230.7 Cr (~13% of equity), alongside ₹89.2 Cr capex commitments and 11 unreviewed small units [30][39]. Fifth, AI rival GCAL by Sarine (>50% H1 grading growth) opened a Mumbai SEEPZ lab [36][38]. Sixth, the tape shows 5 distribution days in 25 sessions inside a #28 ranked sector; at ₹432.50, chasing yields just 0.57:1 R:R to our ₹480.00 Base Target [43].

Weighing both cases on 45.18 Cr fully diluted shares produces a 12–18 month expected value of ₹461.25. The table below compares returns from the live 2026-11-25 close (₹432.50) against our tightened ₹395.00 entry ceiling. Lowering the entry zone from ₹405.00 to ₹380.00–₹395.00 restores solid asymmetry even after trimming our Base Target to ₹480.00.

web_blocks.html:
Multi-Horizon Investment Judgment:
• Short-Term Trading (1–12 weeks): Pass / Wait for Confirmed Support. Price stays +9.90% above the 10-week EMA and +18.52% above the 50-DMA (+19.71% NSE ledger), with 5 distribution days and no listed options. Wait for ₹380.00–₹395.00 plus volume confirmation.
• Medium-Term Inflection (3–12 months): Wait for Support. Post-GIA volume gains (+31% sales) and AGL/Botswana scale support earnings, yet FII/DII selling and MPS supply require buying strictly at weekly support.
• Long-Term Compounding (2–5 years): Tier-2 Core Alpha Compounder. Asset-light 69.2% ROCE and ₹1,074.9 Cr cash merit ownership at the right price. Keep at Tier 2 until Blackstone's MPS sale, Surat ECL reserves, and India margins stabilize.

web_blocks.title: Opportunity-Cost Verdict: Why Cash Wins Today Over Immediate Equity Alternatives

web_blocks.html: We test our next marginal ₹1,00,000 cash unit (from ₹14.21 lakh Zerodha cash) against two live peers on 2026-11-25 TradingView (with 2026-11-23 NSE ledger closes noted). Shortlist IT compounder Coforge (COFORGE) closed at ₹2,060.00 live TV (₹2,142.30 on 2026-11-23 NSE) with a ₹1,685.64 stop and ₹2,620.00 target (1.50:1 live R:R). Yet Zerodha already holds 41 Coforge shares (2.06% weight), and its 23.5% ROCE at 40.4x P/E trails IGIL's 69.2% ROCE at 29.05x P/E. Outside jewelry peer Kalyan Jewellers (KALYANKJIL) closed at ₹636.35 live TV (₹652.90 on 2026-11-23 NSE) at 41.1x P/E, 5.5% OPM, 21.2% ROCE, and 0.92x leverage. An illustrative ₹750.00 target against its ₹503.76 stop offers just 0.86:1 R:R. Keeping 100% of marginal cash in INR awaiting IGIL's confirmed ₹380.00–₹395.00 pullback (1.88:1–3.31:1 R:R) wins decisively.

Thesis Kill-Switches & Volume-Confirmed Execution Checklist: Five clear breaks would void this thesis. First, ex-AGL revenue per report drops over 10% YoY for two straight quarters. Second, consolidated OPM falls below 50% or India standalone margin drops under 65%. Third, debtor days top 75 days or Surat stress forces ECL reserves back above 6%. Fourth, FII/DII combined ownership keeps falling below 14.26% into a discounted block that breaks pricing discipline, or GCAL/GIA takes core LGD share. Fifth, shares close below ₹349.83 on heavy volume. Do not deploy Tranche 1 on quiet drift: require price inside ₹380.00–₹395.00 with Daily RSI under 55, confirmed by a green bounce on >1.2x 20-day average volume and a 4-hour momentum reclaim.

Action Trigger (New Capital & Hard Stop): Wait for Support. Stage up to 6.5% NAV (~701 shares across two ~350-share tranches) strictly inside ₹380.00–₹395.00 only after Daily RSI resets below 55 and a green reversal session prints >1.2x 20-day volume with a 4-hour reclaim. Enforce a hard daily-close stop at ₹349.83.

book_paragraphs: We have now completed a full forensic refresh and adversarial stress test of International Gemological Institute—checking fifty years of history, four business engines, six concrete watchpoints, a 22x-to-28x diluted valuation matrix, and a Stage 2 chart showing five stock-specific distribution days alongside steady institutional selling. Now it is time for a disciplined, unambiguous judgment.

On business quality, IGIL stays a Compounder Pass with Pass-with-Watch KPIs: 69.2% ROCE, 61.4% consolidated Q2 margins, ₹415.7 crore in first-half operating cash flow (118% of net profit), ₹1,074.9 crore in cash, zero bank debt, a clean ICRA IPO audit, and dismissal of the KS Trade LLC lawsuit. Yet honest underwriting demands charging every risk up front: Blackstone's 76.55% MPS deadline, FII (-176 bps) and DII (-91 bps) selling, 4.52% sponsor-linked ESOP dilution, India standalone's -340 bps margin dip, Q2's low 24% tax rate and ₹64 crore TTM treasury income, the 10% U.S. diamond tariff colliding with 1.82% ECL reserves, and GCAL by Sarine's Mumbai SEEPZ lab.

book_subsections.title: Why Stress-Testing Trims Our Target to ₹480 and Tightens Entry to ₹380–₹395
paragraphs: Charging modest post-GIA multiple normalization into our diluted model trims our Base Target from ₹500.00 to ₹480.00—valuing ₹800 crore of FY28E net profit (₹17.71 diluted EPS at 27% tax across 45.18 crore shares) at 27.1 times earnings. Pairing that Base Case (50% weight) with our ₹585.00 Bull Case (25%) and ₹300.00 Bear Case (25%) sets our 12-to-18-month probability-weighted expected value at ₹461.25.

Look how decisively that math resolves the entry question. At the live November 25 close of ₹432.50 (₹431.10 on the November 23 NSE ledger), upside to ₹480.00 is just 11.0% while downside to our ₹349.83 stop is 19.1%—a lopsided 0.57-to-1 chase. Lowering our actionable entry fence to ₹380.00–₹395.00—centered on the rising 10-week EMA (₹393.53) and lower support (₹387.63)—restores 1.88-to-1 Base reward-to-risk at ₹395.00, 2.44-to-1 at ₹387.63, and 3.31-to-1 at ₹380.00, while lifting expected-value asymmetry to 1.47-to-1 through 2.69-to-1. Our independent New-Capital Verdict stays firmly Wait for Support.

callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION: VOLUME CONFIRMATION GUARDS AGAINST DISTRIBUTION
callouts.text: When a Stage 2 stock carries 5 distribution days and FII/DII outflows, touching ₹395 is necessary—but not sufficient. Waiting for a >1.2x volume green bounce and 4-hour reclaim makes institutions prove they are buying before your cash joins them.

book_subsections.title: Checking Your Ledger & Sizing by Tier-2 Risk Budget
paragraphs: Anchor every sizing calculation to the real portfolio. Per our November 23, 2026 Zerodha IN ledger (latest trade synced November 25), net worth is ₹42.64 lakh—₹28.43 lakh across eighteen equities and ₹14.21 lakh in cash (33.3% of NAV). You hold zero shares of IGIL, so Holding Action is Not Held and shares to sell equals zero.

Once IGIL pulls into ₹380.00–₹395.00 and triggers our volume-confirmed bounce, Tier-2 Core Alpha rules assign a 75-basis-point risk budget (₹31,982 maximum loss). Dividing 0.75% by the tighter 11.44% stop distance between ₹395.00 and our ₹349.83 hard stop gives 6.56%, which caps cleanly at Tier 2's 6.5% ceiling—roughly ₹2.77 lakh notional, or 701 shares (₹31,664 max loss). Splitting that across two roughly 350-share tranches around ₹395.00 and ₹385.00 keeps risk tightly controlled.

Outside jewelry peer Kalyan Jewellers trades at ₹636.35 live TV (₹652.90 on the November 23 ledger) at 41.1 times earnings, 5.5% margins, and 0.92 times leverage, offering just 0.86-to-1 R:R to an illustrative ₹750.00 target against its ₹503.76 stop. book_subsections.title: Written Kill-Switches & Closing Word
paragraphs: Keep five objective kill-switches taped above your screen: ex-AGL revenue per report falling more than 10% year-on-year for two consecutive quarters; consolidated EBITDA margin breaking under 50% or India standalone margin slipping under 65%; debtor days rising past 75 days or Surat tariff defaults pushing ECL reserves above 6%; continued FII/DII exits below 14.26% into a discounted block that undermines fee discipline; or a heavy-volume daily close below ₹349.83.

Absent those breaks, our playbook is crystal clear. Refuse to chase ₹432.50 at 0.57-to-1 odds. Hold 100% marginal cash, watch ₹380.00–₹395.00, demand a >1.2x volume green bounce plus 4-hour reclaim, size strictly at 6.5% NAV against our ₹349.83 hard stop, and let a 69%-ROCE certification toll-booth compound on your terms.
